scope: Preliminary low-power pipeline evidence only. Candidate fbe3edc used the older persistent Checked badges. These timings do not measure the final subtle-loading/no-approved-badge UI at 62b72c6.
selection: Only completed before/after pairs with the same scenario and repeat, valid recorded geometry/pixel/media checks, no browser errors, matching source hashes and per-trial quiet/power/powersave metadata. Aborted/incomplete trials excluded. Modes were recorded at trial start, not continuously.
aggregation: Median of per-trial metrics within each side. Percentiles are not pooled across trials. Exactly two completed pairs per scenario; descriptive preliminary results, without a statistical-significance claim.
